title: Keeps drinks hot or cold. No leak proof
text: Keeps drinks hot or cold. No leak proof. This cups is nice, keeps drinks hot or cold.  It's not leak proof if turned on it's side.  It doesn't gush out but it definitely leaks from the spout area.  It fits well in the cup holder.
